Dear Miss Yonge	
[illegible] the [Chaplet](/book/69) duly arrived. The minimal changes you propose seem to me quite sufficient. Benson will do very well. He was in my young days a popular gentleman on the stage - at least in London which was my only way of hearing about such things.
[I](/person/939)will write you about the other matter in a day or to. St John’s seems to me very similar to the earlier one. I had an idea of making a [illegible] divine to [illegible]. perhaps some division might be well.
Yours very truly
A. Macmillan
